events.title: 🚀 Underpacked! is joining Steam Next Fest! 📦✨
events.summary: 🚀 Underpacked! is joining Steam Next Fest! 📦✨ Attention, crew! We've got some exciting news for you! 👀The spaceship is all fueled up and getting ready for its next big adventure, and this time, we're taking Underpacked! to Steam Next Fest! 🌌👉🏼 From October 19 to 26, we'll be part of Steam Next Fest!That's right! For an entire week, you'll have the chance to jump into the world of Underpacked!, get your hands on our demo, and experience the rewarding world of intergalactic deliveries for yourself

events.title: Underpacked! officially launches on Steam on October 29!
events.summary: ⚠️Attention, valued employees!⚠️Underpacked! officially launches on Steam on October 29! 📦🚀After a long journey of development, iteration and polishing, we’re incredibly excited to finally share the release date for the full game.🎉Underpacked! is a chaotic co-op delivery adventure where two cats try to keep their spaceship running, survive every shift and, somehow, get every package delivered.🐱The countdown is officially on.See you on October 29! 👀
